title: Reinforced-concrete torsion resistance and shear interaction

sourceFiles.coverage: Preserves the canonical NTC 2018 torsion unit and formula asset identifiers.

independentValidation.method: direct independent evaluation of the three NTC 2018 torsion resistance equations
independentValidation.fixture: 300 mm by 500 mm rectangle, 8 mm closed stirrups at 150 mm, four 20 mm longitudinal bars assigned to torsion, C25/30 concrete, B450C steel, cotTheta = 1.5
referenceEquations: TRcd = 2 Ak t f'cd cotTheta / (1 + cotTheta^2)

parityDifferences: The torsion capacities, checks, warnings, assumptions, structured references and serialized results have no known parity differences.
engineeringFunctionality: Usable section-level equilibrium-torsion verification for concrete struts, closed transverse reinforcement, explicitly assigned longitudinal torsion reinforcement, and combined concrete shear-torsion interaction. Compatibility torsion may be explicitly left unanalyzed. Complete detailing and allocation of longitudinal torsion reinforcement relative to flexural reinforcement remain outside this slice.
